title: Learning the Structure of Triangular Transport Maps
abstract: arXiv:2609.37122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Triangular transport maps provide a flexible approach to sampling-based probabilistic modeling, including density estimation, generative modeling, and Bayesian inference. They transform an unknown target distribution into a simpler reference through a monotone triangular map. The map structure is defined by a variable ordering and sparsity pattern, which together encode a directed acyclic graph. Map quality can depend strongly on this structure, yet finding a good structure is computationally expensive because each candidate generally requires fitting a different map. A central challenge is therefore to learn density and structure jointly, while keeping computation manageable as dimension grows. We introduce Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM), which learn the map, ordering, and sparsity jointly. translated_title: 学习三角传输映射的结构
translated_abstract: 三角传输映射为基于采样的概率建模（包括密度估计、生成建模和贝叶斯推断）提供了一种灵活的方法。它们通过一个单调的三角映射，将未知的目标分布变换为一个更简单的参考分布。映射的结构由变量排序和稀疏模式定义，二者共同编码了一个有向无环图。映射的质量可能在很大程度上依赖于这一结构，然而寻找一个好的结构在计算上代价高昂，因为每个候选结构通常都需要拟合一个不同的映射。因此，一个核心挑战是在维度增长时仍能保持计算可控的前提下，联合学习密度与结构。我们提出了自结构化传输映射，它联合学习映射、排序和稀疏性。我们使用 SoftSort 来学习变量排序，并使用 $L_0$ 门控来学习稀疏性，同时保持三角结构。
tldr: 该论文提出了自结构化传输映射（SSTM），利用 SoftSort 和 $L_0$ 门控技术联合学习三角传输映射、变量排序与稀疏模式，从而实现密度与结构的高效联合学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM), which jointly learn the triangular transport map, variable ordering, and sparsity pattern using SoftSort and $L_0$ gates, enabling efficient joint density and structure learning.
